sentences.en: The narrator provides only a few descriptions of the surroundings.
sentences.zh: 讲述者仅提供了少量对环境的描述。

sentences.en: Sir David Attenborough is the most well-known narrator in the world.
sentences.zh: 大卫·阿滕伯勒爵士是世界上最著名的讲述者。

sentences.en: The narrator describes the surroundings only sparingly.
sentences.zh: 讲述者只偶尔描述了周围的环境。

senses.zh: （故事的）讲述者，（戏剧、电影等的）解说员
